race.comment: RUN RUPERT RUN (1) has the strongest exposed maiden profile after a head second at Kalgoorlie as favourite, backed by a third at this track the start prior. He has placed twice from three starts this campaign and has already shown he handles this distance range, so he looks ready to convert. MAYBE MAYBE MAYBE (7) is the clear danger after two sound fourths, the latest in NMW1Y grade at Ascot where she was held up late and beaten a length and a half. BLINDFOLDED (2) is the most interesting debutant, having won a comfortable Lark Hill trial and coming from the Daniel & Ben Pearce yard with Chris Parnham booked, though the wide barrier is the obvious query. CHANTATIOUS (8) resumes from stronger Open company and has trialled soundly at Belmont, has to be kept safe.
